name: Sparse Voxel Octree Leaf Population
aliases: Voxel Fragment to Octree Leaf Writing
definition: Populates leaf nodes of a sparse voxel octree with voxel color, normal, and irradiance data from a flat voxel fragment list.
summary: Sparse Voxel Octree Leaf Population transfers voxel color, normal, and irradiance data into leaf-level texture buffers, differing from other methods by focusing strictly on data packing rather than topology generation.
